tiers.A_clinical_guideline: Clinical guideline or guideline-backed marker. Display with clinical confirmation and clinician action warning.
tiers.A_clinically_actionable_gene_panel: Clinically meaningful when confirmed by validated sequencing or assay. Raw DNA is not sufficient.
tiers.A_clinical_guardrail: Safety rule. Always display/execute before marker interpretation when relevant.
tiers.A_rare_high_effect_when_confirmed: Rare variant can be high effect if clinically confirmed. Consumer array false positives/missingness are major concerns.
tiers.B_replicated_common_marker: Replicated common SNP/locus with modest effect. Show as context, not diagnosis.
tiers.B_polygenic_trait: Trait is polygenic. Requires weighted model, ancestry/platform calibration, and phenotype.
tiers.C_candidate_OR_mechanistic: Mechanistically plausible or candidate evidence. Use as weak context only.
tiers.D_research_only: Research-only. Do not score as actionable.

never_claim: absence of risk from missing marker
prefer_language: requires clinical confirmation if high stakes
